name: Customer
description: Central data model for customer records including personal contact information, company affiliation, industry classification, and relationship status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the customer

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: Full name of the customer contact person

fields.name: email
fields.description: Primary email address for customer communication

fields.name: phone
fields.description: Primary phone number for customer contact

fields.name: companyName
fields.description: Name of the company the customer is affiliated with

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Industry classification of the customer's business

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current relationship status (e.g., active, inactive, prospect, churned)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the customer record was created

name: Company
description: Stores company and organization details associated with customers

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the company

fields.name: name
fields.description: Legal business name of the company

fields.name: industry
fields.description: Industry sector or business category

fields.name: size
fields.description: Company size category (e.g., Small, Medium, Enterprise)

fields.name: location
fields.description: Primary business location or headquarters address

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.description: Primary corporate contact email address

fields.name: contactPhone
fields.description: Primary corporate contact phone number

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the company record was created

relationships.description: A company can have multiple customers

name: SalesPipelineStage
description: Defines configurable stages in the sales pipeline with ordering, probability weights, and transition rules for managing lead progression

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the pipeline stage

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the stage (e.g., Prospecting, Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation, Closed Won)

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sequential order of the stage in the pipeline (lower numbers appear first)

fields.name: probability
fields.description: Win probability percentage for deals in this stage (0-100)

fields.name: isFinal
fields.description: Indicates if this is a terminal stage (Closed Won/Lost) with no further progression

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this stage is currently active and available for use

fields.name: allowedTransitions
fields.description: Array of stage IDs that deals can transition to from this stage

name: User
description: Stores user accounts with role-based access control for sales representatives, managers, and administrators

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the user

fields.name: email
fields.description: User's email address for authentication and communication

fields.name: fullName
fields.description: User's full name for display purposes

fields.name: passwordHash
fields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication

fields.name: role
fields.description: User role defining access level (sales_rep, manager, admin)

fields.name: teamId
fields.description: Reference to the team the user belongs to

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is active

fields.name: lastLoginAt
fields.description: Timestamp of the user's last login

email.message: Must be a valid email address

role.message: Role must be one of: sales_rep, manager, admin

name: ActivityLog
description: Maintains comprehensive audit trail of all system activities including data changes, user actions, automated processes, and system events for compliance and troubleshooting

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the activity log entry

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user who performed the action (null for system-generated activities)

fields.name: activityType
fields.description: Type of activity (e.g., CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, EXPORT, SYSTEM_EVENT)

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Type of entity affected (e.g., Customer, Company, SalesPipelineStage, User)

fields.name: entityId
fields.description: Identifier of the specific entity that was affected by the activity

fields.name: details
fields.description: JSON string containing detailed information about the activity, changes made, or additional context

fields.name: ipAddress
fields.description: IP address from which the activity originated

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the activity occurred

relationships.description: Links activity log entry to the user who performed the action

indexes.name: idx_activity_timestamp
indexes.description: Index for efficient time-based queries and log retrieval

indexes.name: idx_activity_user
indexes.description: Index for retrieving all activities by a specific user

indexes.name: idx_activity_entity
indexes.description: Composite index for tracking all activities related to a specific entity

constraints.retention: Activity logs should be retained according to compliance requirements (typically 7 years)
constraints.immutable: Activity log entries should never be modified or deleted once created

name: Team
description: Groups users into sales teams with team leaders, territories, and shared customer assignments for collaboration and performance tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the team

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the sales team

fields.name: teamLeaderId
fields.description: Reference to the User who leads this team

fields.name: territory
fields.description: Geographic or market territory assigned to the team

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the team is currently active

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the team was created

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the team was last updated

name: Lead
description: Track potential customers through the sales pipeline with qualification status and conversion probability

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the lead

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the lead contact or organization

fields.name: source
fields.description: Origin of the lead (e.g., website, referral, trade show, cold call)

fields.name: qualificationStatus
fields.description: Current qualification level (e.g., unqualified, qualified, disqualified)

fields.name: pipelineStageId
fields.description: Reference to current stage in the sales pipeline

fields.name: estimatedValue
fields.description: Potential revenue value of the lead in currency units

fields.name: conversionProbability
fields.description: Likelihood of conversion to customer as percentage (0-100)

fields.name: assignedUserId
fields.description: Reference to the user responsible for managing this lead

relationships.description: Lead belongs to a specific pipeline stage
Lead is assigned to a user
Lead can be converted to a customer
Lead has multiple activity logs tracking interactions

constraints.qualificationStatus: Must be one of: unqualified, qualified, disqualified

name: CommunicationLog
description: Comprehensive log of all customer interactions including emails, calls, meetings, and notes with outcomes tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the communication record

fields.name: communicationType
fields.description: Type of communication (email, phone_call, meeting, note, chat)

fields.name: relatedEntityType
fields.description: Type of entity this communication relates to (customer, lead, company)

fields.name: relatedEntityId
fields.description: ID of the related customer, lead, or company

fields.name: userId
fields.description: ID of the user who initiated or logged the communication

fields.name: communicationDate
fields.description: Date and time when the communication occurred

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Brief subject or title of the communication

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Detailed summary of the communication content and outcomes

relationships.description: Communication related to customer (when relatedEntityType is customer)
Communication related to lead (when relatedEntityType is lead)
Communication related to company (when relatedEntityType is company)

indexes.description: Index for querying communications by related entity
Index for querying communications by user

relatedEntityType.description: Valid entity types for communication tracking

name: Notification
description: Manages system notifications and alerts for users including task reminders, status updates, and assignment changes with delivery channel and read status tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification

fields.name: userId
fields.description: Reference to the user receiving the notification

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of notification (task_reminder, status_update, assignment_change, system_alert)

fields.name: message
fields.description: Notification message content

fields.name: isRead
fields.description: Indicates whether the notification has been read by the user

fields.name: deliveryChannel
fields.description: Channel through which notification is delivered (in_app, email, sms, push)

fields.name: relatedEntityType
fields.description: Type of related entity (lead, customer, activity, etc.)

fields.name: relatedEntityId
fields.description: ID of the related entity that triggered the notification

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the notification was created

relationships.description: Each notification belongs to one user

indexes.description: Optimize queries for user's unread notifications
Optimize queries for notifications related to specific entities

name: Task
description: Manages follow-up tasks, reminders, and scheduled activities with due dates, priorities, and completion tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the task

fields.name: title
fields.description: Brief title or subject of the task

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of task (call, meeting, email, reminder, follow-up)

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Date and time when the task is due

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority level (low, medium, high, urgent)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status (pending, in-progress, completed, cancelled)

fields.name: assignedToUserId
fields.description: ID of the user assigned to complete the task

fields.name: relatedEntityId
fields.description: ID of related entity (Customer, Lead, or Company)

indexes.description: Optimize queries for user's active tasks
Optimize queries for upcoming and overdue tasks
